title: 航空流体力学B
subtitle: Aerodynamics B
educationalGoal: Students will learn the basics of aerodynamics through lectures and exercises on aircraft wings. The goal of this subject is to understand the phenomena that occur in compressible and viscous fluids, and solve fluid problems using mathematical formulas.
advice: We will study compressible and viscous fluids and how to apply the theory to airplane wings. We will cover the following materials: 1. Governing equations of fluids 2. Sonic speed and Mach number 3. Vertical shock waves and oblique shock waves 4. Shock waves generated around wings 5. Aerodynamic characteristics of high-speed airfoils 6. Boundary layer 7. Laminar and turbulent flows and transition of boundary layer 8. Derivation of boundary layer equations 9. Separation and wake vortex 10. Aerodynamic drag
books: Introduction of Aerodynamics (in Japanese) Maruzen Publishing

Be able to explain the effects of viscosity of a fluid acting on an object.
